lead.headline: Rice and Barkley miss again; the Sunday cards are gone
lead.deck: ESPN zeroed both after second DNPs. The lineup is the projection lineup — and the opponent just lost his quarterback.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice and Saquon Barkley both missed practice again on Thursday, and ESPN now projects each at 0.0; this morning's plans to slot Rice into the flex or Barkley in for Tuten are withdrawn. Barkley's quarterback, Jalen Hurts, is out with a blood clot. Next week is worse: Jacksonville's bye takes Lawrence, your only quarterback, with Tuten and Strange. This week is better than it looked at breakfast. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 119.5, after midday swaps to the Patriots' defence and Matt Gay at kicker, and Los Cachanillas start Hurts at quarterback. ESPN has you at 63%, up from 53%.
